description:
THE ROLE

We’re looking for Robot Operations Engineer who are passionate about robotics. This is a hands-on role where you will operate bimanual robots in R&D environments. You will follow structured procedures to collect high-quality robot data. This data is foundational to creating robots that perform tasks in the wild autonomously.



Responsibilities

 - Assemble, test, and validate engineering systems.

 - Accurately collect data consistent with a high internal quality bar

 - Maintain clear record of completed workflows and label data using internal tooling 

 - Adhere to all safety guidelines in lab setting

 

Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, mechanical engineering or related fields.

 - Requires strong attention to detail and a proactive approach, including the confidence to raise questions or flag inconsistencies.

 - Ability to follow written and verbal instructions precisely

 - Reliable transportation and ability to commute to office location

 - Thrive in a fast paced environment.

Bonus Qualifications:

 - Excellent physical coordination, spatial awareness, and focus. 

 - Passion for robotics



Benefits & Compensation 

 - Hourly Range: $25 to $30

 - Expect to work 30-40 hours per week, this is a part-time role
